text:
lucas: Hey — hitting a reproducible failure in the Node SDK sample app for embeddings + rerank. Rerank call errors with "vector dims mismatch" even though embeddings length is 1536.

ananya: Which model and SDK version?

lucas: model=all-mpnet-base-v2, SDK=@redwood/sdk v0.12.3. Repro steps: run sample-app/recipes/rerank, then call /rerank endpoint.

lucas: Posting minimal repro snippet:
```js
const emb = await client.embeddings.create({model: 'all-mpnet-base-v2', input: ['q1','q2']});
// emb.data[0].embedding.length === 1536
const resp = await client.rerank.create({model: 'rerank-1', query: emb.data[0].embedding, candidates: [/* list of embeddings */]});
```

devon: Can you paste the actual error payload?

lucas: Error: 400 Bad Request { code: 'DIM_MISMATCH', message: 'expected 1536, got 1024 for candidate[2]' }

ananya: Interesting — are you batching candidates with the batching helper? We've seen helper drop last 512 dims when concat-ing Float32Arrays incorrectly.

lucas: yes using batchingHelper.batchVectors(candidates, batchSize=64) from devex-utils. I tried batchSize=1 and it works. :thinking_face:

devon: That points to a bug in the helper's concatenation or slice offsets. Could also be endianness when serializing for the rerank endpoint.

lucas: Also noticed partial successes: some batches return 200 while one batch returns DIM_MISMATCH, SDK does not retry others — SDK's retry policy treats it as non-retryable.

sdk-bot: New issue created: devex/embeddings-rerank#2345 by lucas — tags: bug, sdk-node, high-pri.

ananya: Quick workaround: set batchSize=1 or pre-validate candidate vector lengths before calling rerank. I'll add a validation helper to devex-utils: ensure(vec.length === modelDims).

devon: Longer term: two PRs — (1) patch batchingHelper to avoid shared-buffer slice bug, (2) change SDK's rerank client to surface DIM_MISMATCH as retryable if it occurred during pack/serialize (and return per-batch diagnostics).

lucas: I can submit failing unit test and attach failing payloads to the issue.

ananya: Thanks — assigning to @devon for batching fix and @lucas for test + repro. Will also add a short note to the sample app README about model dims and a validator snippet.

devon: Plan: reproduce locally, write fix, run CI. If all green, ship patch v0.12.4 and cut hotfix to sample-repo. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

lucas: Nice. One more minor DX friction: onboarding tutorial uses `embeddings` endpoint example that returns raw arrays; the rerank sample expects typed Float32 buffer. I'll add a tiny converter in the tutorial to avoid confusion.

ananya: Good call. Also adding a small blurb about auth/retry nuance: currently a 4xx DIM_MISMATCH from payload validation -> non-retryable. We'll document recommended retry strategy for batch-level failures.

infra-bot: Deploy window scheduled for 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC. Please flag if hotfix needs emergency deploy.

devon: If patch looks safe we'll target next deploy, otherwise request emergency.

lucas: I've uploaded sample payloads to the issue and included the failing candidate blob. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:

ananya: :rocket:
